articles.title: Trump credit card cap would cause once in a lifetime battle from banks
articles.mainIdea: Trump credit card cap would cause once in a lifetime battle from banks
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Trump credit card cap would cause once in a lifetime battle from banks. While major bank stocks fall after reporting their fourth quarter earnings, President Trump's suggested 10% cap on credit card fees continues to weigh on the financial sector (XLF) and credit lenders. HSBC Head of US Financials Research Saul Martinez told Yahoo Finance on Tuesday that a policy like this would make the credit card industry largely "unprofitable." Whalen Global Advisors Chairman Chris Whalen explains how bank executives would respond to this type of legislation. Also catch Chris Whalen weigh in on the performance of Big Bank stocks in comparison to smaller counterparts. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: AXP, BAC, C, COF, COF-PK, COF-PL, COF-PN, JPM, MA, SYF-PB, WFC, XLF.
